column1: # The Photographer alive in every pose (scripts/enemies/tourist_brain.gd), and the ears in a tight spot (scripts/night/nightmare_fx.gd): id, seconds, destination, prompt.

column4: A man trying to hum a cheerful old holiday tune through a broken crushed throat: wet gargling and bubbling, the tune breaking up, choking pauses, then humming on as if nothing were wrong, about eight metres away in a forest at night, loopable, disgusting, no music.

A man humming a cheerful tune with his mouth stuffed full of crumpled wet paper, muffled and gurgling, coming from low down near the ground, now and then breaking into a muffled whimper, outdoors at night, loopable, no music.
A broken twisted neck slowly creaking as the head sways on it: wet gristle stretching, cartilage clicking, loose vertebrae grinding, close, disgusting, no music.
A sudden violent spasm of a broken neck: a sharp bone pop, a wet snap and a short gristly crunch, close, no music.
A heavy head dangling and swinging on a long limp torn neck: slow wet creaking like a stretched rope, dripping, a soft slap of wet skin, close, disgusting, no music.
A man screaming with his mouth crammed full of crumpled wet photographs: a muffled choking paper-rustling scream that cuts off into a gurgle, close, horrifying, no music.
Wet crumpled instant photographs rustling and crackling inside a mouth, a jaw slowly chewing on paper, saliva, close, disgusting, no music.
Thick blood dripping steadily onto gravel and dry pine needles, slow heavy drops, close, at night, no music.
One heavy hiking boot stepping on gravel and the other foot dragging behind it, uneven limping steps, a wet squelch in the boot, outdoors at night, about six metres away, no music.
A single camera shutter click and the whirr of film advancing, far away in a dark pine forest at night, faint, a little echo off the trees, no music.
A middle-aged man chuckling softly through a mouthful of wet paper and blood, bubbling, very pleased with himself, close, no music.
Wet rattling breathing through a crushed windpipe, each breath whistling and bubbling, slow, close, loopable, disgusting, no music.
A camera on a strap knocking and rattling against a body, plastic clacks, clumsy fingers fumbling on its buttons, close, no music.
A man coughing out a crumpled wet photograph from his mouth, a wet hack and the paper slapping onto gravel, close, disgusting, no music.
A dislocated jaw clicking and grinding as it opens and shuts by itself, wet bone on bone, close, disgusting, no music.
A broken camera flash stuttering: three fast irregular electric pops with a crackling high whine between them, close, no music.
A frightened person's own breathing heard from inside their head: fast shallow breaths through the nose and mouth, trying to stay quiet, trembling, very close, loopable, no music.
A dry nervous swallow heard from inside the head, the click of the throat, very close, no music.
An ear popping from pressure inside the head: a muffled thump and a soft crackle, no music.
